script_text: Stop! Gemini, the stars are screaming at you right now. Mercury is in a sharp square to Saturn in the 2nd House, creating tension between your need for financial security and your thirst for adventure. This transit connects to a square in the 11th House, amplifying pressure to seek new friends. You will attract a partner who challenges your need for independence, perhaps someone with a strong Mars influence in the 11th House, pushing you to confront your fears about commitment. Your 6th House of daily work will be disrupted by a square from Mars, delaying a career advancement or causing health stress, while your 7th House of partnerships shows a tense Moon square to Uranus, creating emotional volatility. Avoid the temptation to overcommit today, as Mercury in the 3rd House makes you overextend and burn out. Subscribe now so you don't miss what's coming next week.
